exclusionPolicy.mobile-or-typical-location: mobile_ambush and rec_policeman are transient positions; a fixed database must not claim them (24h freshness rule of the source policy)
exclusionPolicy.non-enforcement-poi: hazard and signpost POIs (bad_road, dang_*, begin_village, crosswalk, speed_limit, ...) are not enforcement devices and have no record kind in the bundle schema
exclusionPolicy.other-region: points attributed to neighbouring regions stay out of the RU-KLU bundle
exclusionPolicy.outside-region-bounds: positions outside the validator bounds cannot enter the runtime database

dedupe.note: A community point within 60 m of an existing OSM/GIBDD/owner record is skipped: the existing record keeps its road-zone guidance and provenance. Spot check 2026-11-12: skipped points sit 20-35 m from known devices, i.e. the same physical camera.

controlMapping.static_cam/speed_cam: speed + flags(rows->lane, pedestrians->pedestrian, markings->signs_marking, overtaking->road_position); chord/autodoria add average
controlMapping.control_cam_red: redlight; stopLine/stopCrossroad->stopline; bSpeed->speed with numeric limit; same flag mapping
controlMapping.video_control: camera; only flag-derived controls, no speed claim without bSpeed
controlMapping.dummy: camera with empty controls, description notes the dummy
controlMapping.stationary_porst_dps: camera with empty controls, description notes the DPS post

limits: numeric limitKmh is copied only for records with a speed control and an integer 5..180 value; otherwise null
direction: dirType 1 keeps the controlled-travel bearing as rawDirection with directionKnown=true; dirType 2 (both directions) and unknown stay directionKnown=false; no road-zone geometry is inferred for community points, guidance falls back to proximity mode
rightsBasis: OpenSpeedcam states the database is freely editable and all points are available for correction, update and download; attribution and per-point links retained
completenessCheck: bounds response (5434 points) equals the sum of four quadrant responses (5434 unique ids) — no server-side truncation at this zoom level
